Scene:
发现了夹竹桃有毒。别人看到他，很快给他吃一个灵芝。神农一吃就觉得比较好。然后，他继续写他发现的信息。会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 发现了夹竹桃有毒：it is unclear that夹竹桃refers to黄色的花
- 别人看到他：另外一个人，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能不能吃：也会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能吃，哪个植物不能吃

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 哪一个植物能不能吃：哪一种植物能吃，哪一种不能吃，An embedded question should either ask which plants can be eaten or whether a particular plant can be eaten; it should not combine a selection question with a yes-or-no form in this way. [rule: none]
Run 2: 哪一个植物能不能吃：哪一种植物能吃，哪一种植物不能吃，哪一个 asks which single item, while 能不能 asks a yes-or-no question; use parallel clauses to explain which plants are edible and which are not. [rule: none]
Run 3: 哪一个植物能不能吃：哪一种植物能吃，哪一种植物不能吃，Do not combine a selection question with an A-not-A question in the same noun phrase; state the two categories clearly. [rule: none]

output.reason: All runs identify the improper combination of 哪一个 with 能不能 and correct it with parallel edible/non-edible clauses.
